user.title: Connect to Shopping List
user.description: Enter the Worker's base URL and a bearer session token. Get a token by calling POST {base_url}/auth/email/start with your email, then POST /auth/email/verify with the code emailed to you — the response's `session` field is the token.

webhook_info.title: Set up push sync
webhook_info.description:
To sync instantly when changes happen outside Home Assistant, set these as secrets on the Worker:

```
wrangler secret put HA_WEBHOOK_URL
{webhook_url}

wrangler secret put HA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
{webhook_secret}
```

Then redeploy the Worker. HA will also poll every 20 minutes as a fallback. Click Submit to finish setup.
